name: myocyte enhancer factor 2C

function.text: MEF2C encodes myocyte-specific enhancer factor 2C. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia, stereotypic hand movements, and impaired language (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Microsecretory adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
